decision.reason: Robot 0 is close-commanded at the near-right corner and robot 1 at the near-left; neither grasp is verified. Lift together slightly, keeping the shirt body table-supported, to check whether cloth follows each gripper and whether distinct opening lips become visible.

Robot 1's corner appears to follow its lift; robot 0's base settling largely canceled its fingertip rise. Raise robot 0 slightly more than robot 1 to test both supports and expose the near-edge opening, keeping the shirt body on the table.

Robot 0's right corner and robot 1's left corner now appear to follow their rises, but the apparent body rim remains flattened. Tilt both wrists upward with compensating arm retraction to expose its boundaries while preserving both grips and table support.

Robot 0 and robot 1 retain visibly following corner patches. Wrist tilting exposed folds, but the rim remains narrow. Bring both corners slightly inward while raising them gently to reduce lateral tension and test whether the folds separate, keeping the body table-supported.

Both corners follow their grippers, but the shaping motions leave only a narrow slit. Robot 1 will retain its corner anchor while the body rests on the table. Open only robot 0 to begin the single regrasp toward the separately visible lower rim just inward of its corner.

Robot 0 is open, above and outside the exposed lower rim; robot 1 retains its corner anchor and the body remains table-supported. Make the first placement adjustment: lower robot 0, yaw inward and retract slightly toward the visible rim, then inspect before closing.

Robot 0 moved inward; the exposed rim now spans its open jaws but appears below the closing line. Robot 1 retains corner support. Make the second and final placement correction slightly downward and backward, allowing the existing yaw target to settle before inspecting.

Robot 0's open jaws now bracket the selected rim region; robot 1 retains its corner anchor. Close robot 0 with the body table-supported and both arms stationary. The new support and which boundary it controls still require a motion test.

Robot 0's selected rim is gathering between its fingers, but measured finger motion shows closure is still underway. Robot 1 retains its anchor and the body remains table-supported. Hold existing targets briefly before testing cloth support.

Robot 0 has gathered the selected rim after closure; robot 1 retains its original corner. Make a short coordinated lift test with the body still table-supported, checking cloth following at each grip separately and whether the new arrangement controls distinct opening boundaries.

Robot 1's corner followed the lift, but robot 0's selected rim appears to recede as its fingers close further. The single regrasp has not verified two supports or distinct opening boundaries. Lower both toward table support while preserving grip intent.

Robot 0's regrasp remains unverified; robot 1 retains its corner anchor. The shirt body is table-supported, but the single regrasp and two placement corrections did not establish two supports or a usable opening. End with dressing incomplete and grip intent preserved.
